title: D3: real-time data path (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: two speeds. Slow updates (few/sec or less: durable scene records, object placed) = ordinary MLS application messages through relays (ephemeral where appropriate). Fast updates (10-60 Hz poses, input) = WebRTC data channel on the call path (mesh ≤4, SFU above), E2EE with MLS-exporter-derived keys (SFrame-style), SFU forwards blindly and is not an MLS member. A scene is a call that may have no audio.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-16 and applied in spec (13, 05, 06, 11, 14, profiles of jmap family)
